algorithm.logical_world_size: manifest.world_size fixes 2-4 logical ranks and the exact document partition; it is never changed during recovery
algorithm.physical_workers: each execution attempt selects 1-4 actual spawned local processes, independently of logical rank count, within immutable max_processes admission
algorithm.mapping: logical rank r is assigned to physical worker slot r modulo physical_workers; each slot executes its logical jobs in rank order from identical pinned barrier weights
algorithm.aggregation: parent validates every logical rank result and reduces active logical rank updated float64 parameters in ascending logical rank order, independent of physical placement; idle logical ranks do not dilute the mean
algorithm.optimizer: existing per-document globally clipped plain SGD; optimizer semantics, logical batch width and ordering remain fixed during physical resize
algorithm.randomness: manifest seed initializes parameters once; SGD has no stochastic draws, shuffling or dropout; resizing creates no RNG streams
algorithm.equivalence: bit-identical weights and consumed logical document/target positions across fixed-process and resized executions of the same logical-rank averaging algorithm

persistence.boundary: same full barrier checkpoint transaction; elastic membership receipt, complete logical rank receipts, full averaged weights, optimizer settings, epoch/document cursor and cumulative usage commit together under the current parent worker fence and dataset authority guard
persistence.membership_lineage: each committed barrier records the physical roster, logical assignment, current recovery epoch, preceding membership digest/epoch/count, consumed source position and cumulative resize count
persistence.archive: explicit elastic schema validation reuses the same bounded CAS archive and fenced restore authority; physical resizing does not change immutable binding or restored learned parameters
persistence.rollback: failed or interrupted attempts preserve the previous committed barrier; all current physical workers and IPC helpers are stopped and joined before the attempt returns

binding.max_physical_workers: integer floor of immutable manifest max_processes, capped at four; defaults to four when max_processes is absent

resume_payload.rank_receipts: existing complete logical rank receipt fields; logical ranks assigned to the same physical slot share its actual PID, while the physical roster must contain distinct PIDs
resume_payload.budgets: existing cumulative logical target/document/byte/epoch/barrier limits never reset on recovery; max_processes bounds actual concurrent physical workers and is immutable across resizing

recovery: validate exact dataset, code/config, runtime, initialized base identity and cumulative budgets before worker allocation
advance the existing parent worker epoch before restoring the authoritative committed checkpoint of a failed/running attempt
select a new physical count only at a restart boundary; preserve immutable logical ranks, full optimizer configuration and consumed data cursor
replay only the first uncommitted logical barrier after failure; no committed logical document update is repeated
physical roster changes require a newer recovery epoch and produce explicit membership lineage in the next committed barrier
completed reload and retry return the recorded membership artifact without spawning workers or rewriting receipts from the latest requested physical count
failure_drills: stale parent and stale logical rank receipt rejection
revocation after logical updates before checkpoint
physical and cumulative budget denial before allocation
checkpoint tamper and conflicting logical-rank/config retry
CAS backup/reimport followed by changed physical count

limits.numerical_limits: unchanged native neural hidden-size, document, corpus, epoch and cumulative target limits

scope_limitations: one machine; physical process restart elasticity only
fixed logical rank and effective batch semantics
no live resizing, remote coordinator, GPU collectives, topology optimization or optimizer rescaling
no model quality, production promotion or masterplan signoff claim
membership lineage is issued by the trusted existing SQLite writer; retained receipts bind preceding membership digests without attesting a rewritten full history after pruning
